name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Daniel Obajtek
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of its member Daniel Obajtek. Polish prosecutors want to charge him with perjury over testimony he gave in 2023 in a Warsaw civil case, before he became a member. They also link him to an alleged offence over removing a magazine from sale at petrol stations. Lifting immunity lets the Polish case go ahead. Parliament found no sign the case was brought to harm his political work.

- **What changes:** Daniel Obajtek loses his protection from Polish criminal proceedings, so prosecutors can pursue the case.
- **Who it affects:** Daniel Obajtek, a member of the European Parliament, and the Polish prosecutors handling the case.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Polish authorities and to Obajtek.
